findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote_link, list_guides, get_guide · Private data: check_incentives, estimate_production, get_node_score, get_quote_link, route_lead, list_guides, get_guide, find_local_installers · Public sink: get_quote_link, route_lead, answer_energy_assessment_question, submit_contractor_match_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote_link, list_guides, get_guide · Private data: check_incentives, estimate_production, get_node_score, get_quote_link, route_lead, list_guides, get_guide, find_local_installers · Public sink: get_quote_link, route_lead, answer_energy_assessment_question, submit_contractor_match_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
